resolution: Defined an honest test for agent-followed quad cleanup and verified the current observation boundary in source. Native action drain reports only action kind/source and before/after vertex/part counts, while the agent elements vocabulary exposes vertices and boundary edges but not selected face IDs, face loops, adjacency, or logical grouping changes; therefore an agent cannot currently reconstruct the user's exact merge examples from screenshots or percepts. Reduced the required feature to a narrow follow recorder: capture baseline triangle/group adjacency plus the exact selected triangles for each native merge, derive the repeated horizontal grouping pattern, preview one unseen continuation, then apply a complete half-shell wrap atomically and mirror it. Frontier slivers are provisional and validation occurs after the band closes; propagation stops for a manual reseed at poles, seams, boundaries, or mismatched cadence. No code changed.
